event: "Thanks, Marda." Marda grunts and goes back to her ledger.
Nala walks out the south gate and the two miles down to the crossroads.
She sits against the shrine's warm stone. The white-gold threads seep in for three slow hours.

memory.fact: Resting against the shrine, white-gold threads drift to a holy mage and seep in, warm as sun.

event: The shake goes out of her hands. By early afternoon her well is brimming again.

changes.note: Three hours at the shrine fill Nala's well to the brim
Rest at the shrine eases the morning's knocks

memory.fact: Resting at the shrine eases a holy mage's bruises and aches too, as the white-gold seeps in.
Resting at the shrine eases a holy mage's bruises and aches too, as the white-gold seeps in.

event: She walks the two miles back and turns down Brannagh's lane.
One carter sits on the bench, his palm wrapped in a bloody rag.

memory.fact: On day eight's afternoon a carter waits, his palm gashed on an axle bolt that morning, no blight.

event: "Axle bolt," he says. "This morning." The gash is deep, but clean, no gray in it.
Nala lays two fingers along it. The first Mending Weave knits the deep part closed.

changes.note: A Mending Weave closes the deep part of the carter's gash
Mana Weaver's lending in this turn's weaves counts toward its next rank

event: The second smooths the skin over. He flexes his hand and laughs out loud.

changes.note: A second Mending Weave smooths the carter's palm
Mana Weaver's lending in this turn's weaves counts toward its next rank

event: He pays Brannagh ten copper, and she passes it straight to Nala.

changes.note: The carter's ten copper, handed on by Brannagh
Nala came back to Brannagh's lane as promised

memory.fact: The carter's gash is deep but clean; two Mending Weaves close it, and he pays Brannagh's 10 copper.

event: "That's all for today," Brannagh says. "Your washerwoman's due at the dusk bell."

memory.fact: Brannagh told Nala the carter was all for day eight, till the washerwoman at the dusk bell.
